# IXL Canada

> IXL is a comprehensive K-12 adaptive learning platform offering 6500+ practice skills in math, English language arts, and science with personalized diagnostics and real-time analytics.

IXL Canada serves students across all Canadian provinces with curriculum-aligned content, interactive games, instructional videos, and teacher analytics tools. The platform combines gamification, adaptive learning technology, and detailed progress tracking to support personalized education.

## Key Topics

- Adaptive Learning
- K-12 Education
- Math Practice
- English Language Arts
- Science Skills
- Personalized Learning
- Student Analytics
- Gamification
- Interactive Learning
- Skill Practice
- Canadian Curriculum
- Diagnostic Assessment
- Video Tutorials
- Early Learning
- Student Engagement

## Core Learning Subjects

- [IXL Math](https://ca.ixl.com/math): K-12 adaptive math practice from counting to calculus with unlimited questions
- [IXL English Language Arts](https://ca.ixl.com/ela): K-12 adaptive English language arts skills with comprehensive practice coverage
- [IXL Science](https://ca.ixl.com/science): K-10 adaptive science skills with unlimited practice questions across topics

## Teacher & School Tools

- [IXL Analytics](https://ca.ixl.com/analytics): Real-time classroom insights and differentiated instruction tools for educators
- [IXL Diagnostic](https://ca.ixl.com/diagnostic): Personalized assessment tool providing insights and action plans for student progress
- [IXL Membership](https://ca.ixl.com/membership): Subscription plans for families, teachers, and schools with full K-12 curriculum access

## Curriculum & Standards

- [Provincial Curriculum Alignment](https://ca.ixl.com/standards/california): IXL curriculum alignment across Canadian provinces with learning objectives
- [Math Curriculum Standards](https://ca.ixl.com/standards/california/math): Math alignment to Alberta, BC, Manitoba, New Brunswick and other provincial curricula

## Interactive Learning Resources

- [IXL Math Games](https://ca.ixl.com/math/games): Interactive math games for K-12 learners covering multiplication, money, and concepts
- [IXL Math Videos](https://ca.ixl.com/math/videos): Bite-sized instructional videos supporting IXL math skills and concepts
- [IXL English Language Arts Games](https://ca.ixl.com/ela/games): Interactive ELA games for early learners covering ABCs to contractions
- [IXL English Language Arts Videos](https://ca.ixl.com/ela/videos): Instructional videos for ELA concepts supporting IXL skill practice

## Early Learning

- [Junior Kindergarten Math](https://ca.ixl.com/math/jr-kindergarten): Visual counting, number recognition, and foundational math skills for early learners
- [Junior Kindergarten English Language Arts](https://ca.ixl.com/ela/jr-kindergarten): Phonics, letter identification, and early literacy skills for junior kindergarten

## Optional

- [IXL Homepage](https://ca.ixl.com): IXL main landing page with platform overview and 6500+ skills across subjects
- [International Editions](https://ca.ixl.com/international): IXL international editions for US, Australia, Brasil, Canada and other regions
- [Awards Information](https://ca.ixl.com/awards): Gamified rewards system and certificates for student engagement and motivation
